premises.scope: actual original-coordinate invertible indefinite principal pair plus disjoint far physical cross tail; essential boundedness

new_results.statement: For the complete squared-2x2-minor law W of physical K and product Plucker law W0 of the best rank-two truncation, delta=E2(K)-sigma1^2 sigma2^2 <= ||K||_F^2 T2(K), and TV(W,W0) <= 0.5 sqrt(rho)(1+sqrt(1-rho))+rho/2 <= sqrt(rho)+rho/2, rho=delta/E2(K).

If two physical rows and two physical columns each have top-two singular-plane leverage >=h>1/2, then one fixed physical 2x2 minor has squared determinant >=E2(K)[(2h-1)^2-TV(W,W0)]_+. At h=3/4 and rho<=9/4-sqrt(5), this is >=E2(K)/8.

The account02/B07 star/E2 compiler implies rho <= (E/Omega)sqrt(2G_*/S^2). Hence G_* <= (rho0^2/2)S^2 Omega^2/E^2 plus double-heavy left/right top-two planes forces a physical 2x2 minor >=Omega/8; otherwise G_* exceeds that explicit scale.

next_step: Use the near-product Plucker law. If double-heavy fails, isolate the at-most-one-heavy-coordinate side and feed its determinant-weighted E2 mass into the existing E2-to-E1 shadow / mixed-order half-Riesz receiver; retain the large-diagonal and nonzero rank-two-tail branches explicitly.
